title: Check if Array can Form Arithmetic Progression

content.problemStatement:
Given an array of integer , write a program to check whether an Arithmetic progression can be formed or not

For example:

    The given array is: 23,3,18,13,8

    The output is : YES

Explanation:

    Rearrange the array 3,8,13,18,23 which forms the A.p
content.inputFormat:
The first line has the size of the array

Second line contains the elements of the array.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Check if array elements can form an Arithmetic Progression.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = sorted(int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1])
    if n <= 2: print("Yes"); return
    diff = arr[1] - arr[0]
    print("Yes" if all(arr[i+1] - arr[i] == diff for i in range(n - 1)) else "No")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Sort array and check if difference between consecutive elements is uniform.
